Who We Target First

A growing South African company with 10 to 100 staff. One person handling HR and payroll. Currently on Excel, an accountant, or basic payroll software. They need leave management, accurate payslips, and to stay on the right side of SARS, without hiring a specialist or paying enterprise software prices.

Why Now?

  • SARS enforcement of ETI, EMP501 and IRP5 is increasing
  • BCEA and POPIA compliance requirements are growing
  • Post-COVID, businesses want to reduce reliance on external bureaux
  • Cloud software is now affordable and trusted for sensitive data
  • Competing tools are either too simple or too expensive for this segment

Our Advantages

Why Businesses Choose NovaHR

Against direct competitors, these are the differences that matter.
Payroll and HR in One Place
Most competitors are either payroll-only or HR-only. NovaHR does both in a single system, so there is no double data entry and no risk of payroll and leave records being out of sync.
South African Compliance Built In
Not bolted on. PAYE, UIF, SDL, ETI, EMP201, EMP501, IRP5 and Employment Equity are built into the payroll engine. When SARS changes the rules, so does NovaHR.
Pay Via Netcash Directly
NovaHR connects directly to Netcash for bulk salary payments. No need to download a file and upload it somewhere else — the payment flows from payroll approval.
Simple Flat Pricing
One monthly price for all features. No per-employee charges that surprise you as you grow. At 30 employees, NovaHR Growth works out to about R33 per person per month, including payroll.
Modern Design, Easy to Use
Built for business owners and their teams, not payroll professionals. Clean interface, branded payslips, dark mode, and role-based views so each person sees only what they need.
Faster Than a Bureau
Log in, run payroll, approve it, pay staff. No waiting for a third party. The business owner or HR admin is in full control, with a complete audit trail.

Where We Are Growing

What We Are Building Next

We are honest about where we are. Here is the roadmap to make NovaHR impossible to beat in our segment.
Now
(0 to 30 days)

Become the Safest Choice

Two-factor login security (MFA). Annual tax table verification by a registered tax practitioner. A formal migration kit so businesses can move from SimplePay, Sage or Excel safely. Written answers to every security question a buyer might have.

Soon
(30 to 60 days)

Make the Accountant a Partner

A proper accounting journal export (gross pay, net pay, PAYE, UIF, SDL by department) that an accountant can import directly into Xero or Sage Accounting. Once this is done, accountants recommend NovaHR to their clients instead of competing with it.

Soon
(30 to 60 days)

Mobile for Every Employee

A mobile-friendly version employees can install on their phones (PWA). View payslips, apply for leave, check leave balance. Most employees are on their phones, not a desktop.

Next
(60 to 90 days)

Compliance Calendar and Timesheet Input

A dashboard that shows every compliance deadline with a green/amber/red status. Plus the ability to import timesheets for hourly staff so that overtime is calculated automatically in payroll.

Market Position

The Category We Own: SA Compliance-First HR for SMEs

We are not trying to be everything to everyone. We are the best tool for this specific job.

Our Category Statement

"NovaHR is the South African HR and payroll workspace for growing teams. Run compliant payroll, manage leave and employee records, pay staff, and stay on top of SARS and people obligations from one place."

The Businesses We Are Perfect For

  • 10 to 100 employees, single South African entity
  • One HR or office administrator handling people and payroll
  • Currently on Excel, an accountant, or basic payroll software
  • Professional services, agencies, retail head offices, clinics, hospitality groups
  • Want to run payroll themselves and see compliance clearly

What Makes Businesses Switch to NovaHR

  • Payroll mistakes or SARS penalties from Excel errors
  • Leave disputes because no records existed
  • Accountant bills going up for basic payroll processing
  • Business growing past what spreadsheets can handle
  • New HR hire who wants a proper system, not a folder

What We Do Not Try to Do (Yet)

  • Multi-country payroll or global employment (Deel does this)
  • Complex bargaining council payroll or 250+ employee enterprise
  • Fully outsourced payroll service
  • Applicant tracking, learning management or performance reviews
